{
  "milestones": [
    {
      "id": "m1",
      "title": "Fix BarrelList insert IndexError on large negative indices",
      "requests": [
        "R6"
      ],
      "requirement": "BarrelList.insert() should handle large negative indices by clamping them to valid bounds, just like Python's built-in list, instead of raising an IndexError.",
      "observable": "bl = BarrelList([1, 2, 3]); bl.insert(-100, 99); assert bl[0] == 99; assert len(bl) == 4",
      "public_names": [
        "BarrelList.insert",
        "BarrelList._translate_index"
      ],
      "requires": [],
      "why_requires": "The current implementation of _translate_index returns None for out-of-bounds indices, and insert raises IndexError. The fix requires modifying _translate_index or insert to clamp the index."
    },
    {
      "id": "m2",
      "title": "Fix split maxsplit=0 wrapping source object",
      "requests": [
        "R5"
      ],
      "requirement": "iterutils.split(src, sep, maxsplit=0) should return a single-item list containing the original iterable (or its values if it was a string/list), not wrap the entire source object in a way that breaks iteration or returns unexpected types.",
      "observable": "list(split([1, 2, 3], ',', 0)) == [[1, 2, 3]]; split('a,b,c', ',', 0) == ['a,b,c']",
      "public_names": [
        "iterutils.split",
        "iterutils.split_iter"
      ],
      "requires": [],
      "why_requires": "The bug is in how split handles the case where no splitting occurs due to maxsplit=0. It likely wraps the input incorrectly. This is independent of m1."
    },
    {
      "id": "m3",
      "title": "Add human_readable_list to strutils",
      "requests": [
        "R2"
      ],
      "requirement": "Add a function strutils.human_readable_list(items) that formats a list of items into a human-readable string, e.g., 'item1, item2, and item3'.",
      "observable": "human_readable_list([]) == ''; human_readable_list(['a']) == 'a'; human_readable_list(['a', 'b']) == 'a and b'; human_readable_list(['a', 'b', 'c']) == 'a, b, and c'",
      "public_names": [
        "strutils.human_readable_list"
      ],
      "requires": [],
      "why_requires": "This is a new feature addition, independent of the bug fixes in m1 and m2."
    }
  ],
  "expected_causes": [
    "Developers might misunderstand the clamping logic for negative indices in BarrelList, leading to off-by-one errors or incorrect behavior for positive indices.",
    "Developers might struggle with the exact output format expected by human_readable_list, particularly regarding Oxford commas and conjunctions.",
    "Developers might not correctly identify the root cause of the split maxsplit=0 issue, which involves handling the case where no split actually happens."
  ],
  "verifier_plan": "Tests will be written for each milestone. For m1, tests will create a BarrelList and call insert with various negative indices, checking the resulting list content. For m2, tests will call split with maxsplit=0 on different iterables and check the returned structure. For m3, tests will call human_readable_list with various lists and check the output string format."
}
